vinculum.title: Vinculum
vinculum.description: A local-first math editor for equations, curves, surfaces, and vector fields in 2D and 3D. Save work in your browser or share a scene by URL.

LumaWall.title: LumaWall
LumaWall.description: Video wallpapers from local files on macOS, with per-display playback, scheduled playlists, and power-aware controls. Available to build locally.

faredelta.title: FareDelta
faredelta.description: Flexible-date flight search with fare history, saved routes, and price alerts, using cached fare observations.

PuzzleTrack.title: PuzzleTrack
PuzzleTrack.description: A local chess endgame research pilot with reproducible puzzle assignments, timed decisions, and exportable study records.

alove.description: A self-hosted LaTeX workspace with a browser editor, Docker-based TeX Live compilation, and PDF preview. The default local mode needs no account.

Automater.description: A macOS desktop automation app for clicking, recording, and replaying macros.
